profile.name: Daniel Okafor
profile.summary: Supply chain manager with seven years in distribution and inbound logistics for home goods and grocery. Known for fixing carrier performance, cutting freight spend and building simple reports that warehouse teams actually read.

descriptions: Manage inbound freight for 3 distribution centers and a team of 6 planners, about $48M in annual spend
Renegotiated contracts with 9 truckload carriers, saving $2.1M a year while raising on-time delivery from 87% to 95%
Set up a weekly carrier scorecard in Power BI that the VP of Operations reviews with every carrier each quarter
Led the move from spreadsheets to a cloud TMS with no missed shipments during the two-week cutover
Modeled lane costs for 120 shipping lanes and recommended 14 consolidations that saved $640K in the first year
Built an SQL dashboard on detention charges that helped recover $210K in disputed fees from shippers
Trained four analysts on the costing model and wrote the handbook the team still uses
Tracked daily load status for 300 shipments and flagged delays to customer service before customers called
Automated the weekly fuel surcharge report in Excel VBA, saving about 5 hours each week
Scheduled dock appointments for 60 inbound trucks a day and cut average wait time from 2 hours to 40 minutes
Ran cycle counts with the inventory team, raising location accuracy from 92% to 98.5%

educations.degree: Bachelor of Business Administration in Supply Chain Management

descriptions: Systems: SAP S/4HANA, Oracle TMS, Manhattan WMS
Analysis: Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python basics
Certifications: APICS CSCP, Six Sigma Green Belt
